'''Brittney Lee Hamilton''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hamilton was born on January 29, 1985. As an adult, she became a voice actress and also guest-starred in a few American TV shows. Hamilton joined {{aniseries|PTS}} in the beginning of {{aniseries|BW}}. Her most prominent roles are {{an|Iris}}'s [[rival]] [[Georgia]] in ''Pokémon the Series: Black & White'', and new [[island kahuna]] [[Hapu]] in {{aniseries|SM}}.
